title: Lifting outer query addresses
statement: Let $n,\ell,K,s$ be nonnegative integers. The address map from the disjoint union of the $n$ input coordinates and the $\ell$ proof coordinates to the disjoint union of the same input coordinates and $\ell+Ks$ proof coordinates leaves every input address unchanged and sends each proof address to the corresponding coordinate in the initial segment of the enlarged proof space.
hypotheses_covered: An address in the disjoint union of $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and $\mathrm{Fin}(\ell)$
